response.overview: Set in Basque Country in 1609, Coven of Sisters (Akelarre) follows a group of six young village women who are arrested by the Spanish Inquisition while the local men are away at sea. Accused of witchcraft and holding a demonic Sabbath, they soon realize that proving their innocence is impossible to the obsessed judge, Rostegui.
response.title: Coven of Sisters
